note: Defects found by the automated QA suite (tests/qa). One entry per defect; 'cases' are the TC IDs whose check shows it. Status: Open (deferred) — not fixed in this round, with the reason; Open (owner decision) — needs a business decision first; Fixed (re-test pending) — fixed and covered by unit / integration tests, the site run still to confirm; Fixed in part; Fixed - retest passed (with fixedIn and retest); Not changed (by design); Not a defect.

defects.title: Write APIs read the request before checking the session
defects.actual: 19 write routes (15 handlers) answered a signed-out caller 404 NOT_FOUND or 422 VALIDATION_FAILED instead of 401: they validated the body or looked the record up first, so a guest learnt field names and whether an id exists. Nothing could be changed signed out.
defects.expected: 401 for every write API called without a session (TC-SEC-001); guards first (src/server/authz/guards.ts: 'Every mutating route handler and server action begins with one of these').
defects.fix: requireUser() as the first statement of the 15 handlers (orders status/fulfilment/assign/fulfilment-plan, shop-products, excel-uploads, invoices einvoice/eway-bill, products, price-requests, marketing segments, admin payout batches).

defects.title: A malformed id in the URL answers 500
defects.actual: GET /api/shops/abc/products (and other id routes, e.g. PATCH /api/cart/items/undefined) → 500 INTERNAL: PostgreSQL 'invalid input syntax for type uuid' reached the generic error handler.
defects.expected: 404/422 for a malformed id, never a 500 (TC-SEC-002).
defects.fix: toClientError() maps PostgreSQL 22P02 for type uuid to 404 NOT_FOUND (src/lib/errors.ts); unit test tests/unit/errors-invalid-id.test.ts.

defects.title: Responses advertise the framework (X-Powered-By: Next.js)
defects.actual: Every response carries 'X-Powered-By: Next.js'.
defects.expected: No server details in responses (TC-SEC-010).
defects.fix: poweredByHeader: false in next.config.ts.

defects.title: PIN codes starting with 0 (and 000000) are accepted
defects.actual: The location bar saved 'PIN 011001' and 'PIN 000000'; addresses, shop registration and settings, societies, delivery slots, price references and marketing segments accepted any 6 digits.
defects.expected: Only a 6-digit PIN that does not start with 0 is accepted; others are refused with 422 and the previous location stays (TC-LOC-002, TC-FLD-020).
defects.fix: /^[1-9]\d{5}$/ in the location API and the services that store a PIN (addresses, shops, societies, shop profile, delivery slots, price references, marketing).

defects.title: No robots.txt on the test site
defects.actual: GET https://test.gokesari.com/robots.txt → 404, so search engines may index the test site and its test shops.
defects.expected: Search engines are disallowed on the test site (TC-SEC-008).
defects.fix: src/app/robots.ts: Disallow / on every host but gokesari.com (isProductionSite); production keeps Allow /.

defects.title: Shop search by PIN code finds nothing
defects.actual: /shops?q=411014 lists no shop although several approved shops are at PIN 411014 (e.g. 'Agtci', Kharadi): the free-text search matched name, area, city, description and category but not the PIN, and /shops has no separate PIN field.
defects.expected: Shop search by name, category, area and PIN returns the matching approved shops (TC-DISC-004).
defects.fix: searchShops() also matches shops.pincode (src/server/services/shops.ts); integration test in tests/integration/shop-categories.test.ts.

defects.title: A deleted address can still be used at checkout
defects.actual: After DELETE /api/addresses/{id} → 204, POST /api/checkout with that addressId placed a CONFIRMED order delivering to it.
defects.expected: A deleted address can no longer be used; checkout refuses it.
defects.fix: Checkout reads only live addresses (loadAddressSnapshot filters deleted_at); a deleted address is refused.

defects.title: The rider never sees address line 2 (flat, floor)
defects.actual: After pickup /delivery-partner showed line 1, landmark and instructions but not line 2 ('Flat 12B, 3rd floor'); the navigation label had the same gap.
defects.expected: Both address lines as saved.
defects.fix: The rider's drop address and navigation label include address line 2.

defects.title: '+91' typed in a mobile field becomes a different number
defects.actual: '+91 9876543210' in Recipient mobile was kept as '9198765432' — a different valid-looking number — and saved.
defects.expected: +91 is stripped (or refused) the same way everywhere.
defects.fix: mobileFieldDigits() (src/lib/contact.ts) strips +91 / a 12-digit 91… in every 10-digit mobile field.

defects.title: Shops whose hours run past midnight always show Closed
defects.actual: Hours 18:00–02:00 were never open: the check compared open ≤ now ≤ close within one day, so every order asked for the closed-shop confirmation.
defects.expected: Open from the opening time until the close the next morning (IST).
defects.fix: src/lib/shop-hours.ts: hours past midnight are open until the close the next morning (today's or yesterday's hours).

defects.title: Order notes never reach the shop
defects.actual: The checkout API stored notes but the cart had no notes field, and /shop/orders never showed them.
defects.expected: The customer can leave a note; the shop sees it with the order.
defects.fix: Optional note on the cart (sent with checkout); 'Note from the customer' on the shop's order card.

defects.title: Deleting the default address leaves no default
defects.actual: Deleting the default address → 204, then no address was marked default.
defects.expected: Exactly one default address while any address remains.
defects.fix: Deleting the default address makes the newest remaining one the default.

defects.title: 'Show all shops' drops the type and other filters
defects.actual: /shops?type=DAIRY → 'Show all Pune shops' → /shops?all=1&city=Pune; the type was gone.
defects.expected: The toggle keeps the search, type, classification, delivery, open-now and sort filters.
defects.fix: The near-me / all-shops toggle keeps the search, type, classification, delivery, open-now and sort filters.

defects.title: '%' and '_' in a search match everything
defects.actual: /search?q=% (also _ and %%_) returned a full page of products and no 'nothing found' state; the term went into ILIKE unescaped.
defects.expected: Symbols are searched as text.
defects.fix: likePattern() escapes % and _ in product and shop searches.

defects.title: The shop page does not show the minimum order
defects.actual: With a ₹150 minimum, /shops/{slug} showed only the delivery fee line.
defects.expected: The minimum order is shown with the delivery terms.
defects.fix: The shop page shows the minimum order with the delivery terms.

defects.title: A broken product photo stays broken (no placeholder)
defects.actual: An image URL that fails before the page hydrates kept a broken : onError never fired.
defects.expected: A broken photo shows the neutral placeholder.
defects.fix: SafeImage notices an image that failed before hydration and shows the placeholder.

defects.title: A session cookie keeps working after sign-out
defects.actual: A session cookie copied before Sign out still worked afterwards: GET /api/wallet → 200, POST /api/cart → 200 (stateless 30-day JWT, no revocation).
defects.expected: After sign-out the old session is refused everywhere (401 / sign-in page).
defects.fix: Each session has an id; Sign out lists it in revoked_sessions (migration 0088) and every request refuses a listed id — a copied cookie gets 401.

defects.title: An account can be created without accepting the Terms
defects.actual: Submitting /signin with the Terms box unticked still mailed a code and created the account; the server recorded consent unconditionally.
defects.expected: The server refuses a new account without consent.
defects.fix: A new account needs the Terms box: verifyLoginOtp refuses TERMS_REQUIRED without it (existing accounts unaffected).

defects.title: A suspended account's sign-in link shows an error page
defects.actual: 'Email me a link' for a suspended account showed 'Something went wrong on our side' (AccessDenied unhandled).
defects.expected: /signin?error=AccessDenied with the suspended notice.
defects.fix: The email-link, dev and Google forms turn Auth.js's refusal into /signin?error=AccessDenied (suspended notice).

defects.title: A rider who signs out stays online and gets offers
defects.actual: After the rider signed out, isOnline stayed true and the next READY order was offered to them.
defects.expected: Sign-out takes the rider offline.
defects.fix: Sign out sets an online rider offline (a rider mid-delivery keeps the job).

defects.title: The previous user's delivery location survives sign-out
defects.actual: On a shared phone the next person saw 'Deliver to <previous user's spot>' after sign-out.
defects.expected: Sign-out clears the location.
defects.fix: Sign out deletes the location cookie.

defects.title: Sign-out is not audited
defects.actual: Sign-in writes auth.otp_verified; sign-out wrote no audit row.
defects.expected: Sign-out is recorded in the audit log.
defects.fix: Sign out writes auth.signed_out (user, IP, browser) once.

defects.title: After a session expires, sign-in does not return to the page asked for
defects.actual: An expired session on /wallet → /signin, but after the code the person landed on '/'.
defects.expected: Signing in returns to the page that was asked for.
defects.fix: Not fixed: 145 pages redirect to /signin without a return path and /signin ignores callbackUrl. Needs one helper for the redirects plus /signin and onboarding honouring a same-site return path.

defects.title: No risk flag for repeated referral abuse
defects.actual: Four attempts to use one's own referral code, then a risk-rules run, raised no flag (no rewards were paid in any of the abuse paths).
defects.expected: Repeated abuse raises a risk flag.
defects.fix: Own-code tries are recorded (customer_referral.refused); new risk rule REFERRAL_ABUSE flags 3+ tries or refused friend rewards in 30 days (rule riskRules.referralAbuse).

defects.title: A rewarded referral found fraudulent cannot be reversed
defects.actual: A REWARDED referral cannot be flagged and there is no reversal mechanism.
defects.expected: A fraudulent rewarded referral is reversed with a ledger entry.
defects.fix: Not built: reversing a paid referral reward needs a decision on credit already spent (claw back or not) before a ledger reversal is added.

defects.title: Society gate contact '123456' is accepted
defects.actual: PATCH /api/societies/{id} with gateContactPhone '123456' → 200.
defects.expected: The security contact must be a valid phone when given.
defects.fix: Gate contact must be an Indian mobile or a landline with its STD code (isIndianPhone).

defects.title: Society rider mobile is read as its last 10 digits
defects.actual: '1'+rider number (11 digits) and '67456ab20809' were accepted and added that rider.
defects.expected: Wrong length, letters and wrong first digit are refused; +91 is stripped.
defects.fix: Rider mobile read with parseIndianMobile (as typed; +91 stripped), not its last 10 digits.

defects.title: Text in a segment's number field is silently dropped
defects.actual: 'abc' in 'At least this many delivered orders' was dropped and the segment saved as 'All customers'.
defects.expected: The form refuses it and names the field.
defects.fix: The segment form names the field and keeps Save / Preview off while a number field holds text.

defects.title: Reconciliation reports books that agree as UNMATCHED
defects.actual: Wallet, COD and online-paid orders showed actual 0; credited top-ups, settlements with a refund and paid payouts also mismatched: the correlated subqueries compared the subquery's own id, adjustments were ignored and online payments were not counted.
defects.expected: Matched orders reconcile; a changed order stands out.
defects.fix: Every correlated subquery of runReconciliation names its outer column; online payments (captured less refunds) count; refund-pending orders expect 0.

defects.title: A shop cannot remove an unavailable line from an online-paid order
defects.actual: 'Unavailable — remove & refund' → 404 'Original wallet debit for this reference was not found.' (the line refund always used the wallet ledger).
defects.expected: The line is removed and refunded the way the order was paid.
defects.fix: Removing a line or a cheaper substitute refunds the way the order was paid (refundOrderPart: wallet, the original online payment after commit, nothing for COD).

defects.title: Subscription orders carry no delivery address
defects.actual: Orders generated from a subscription had no address snapshot and no society, so the rider had no drop address.
defects.expected: Each delivery carries the subscription's (or the default) address.
defects.fix: Generation uses the subscription's address, else the customer's default; none → NO_ADDRESS (not charged, customer told); the subscribe page picks an address.

defects.title: Wallet 'Add money' is off-screen on a phone
defects.actual: On a 412 px phone the card was 748 px wide; presets, Apply and 'Proceed to payment' could not be tapped.
defects.expected: Everything fits and can be tapped at 360–412 px.
defects.fix: Wallet grid columns minmax(0,1fr) with min-w-0, so nothing widens the page on a phone.

defects.title: Admin money trace shows no payment for an online-paid order
defects.actual: GET /api/finance/orders/<n> → payment: null although the payment intent was CAPTURED.
defects.expected: The trace shows the online payment and its events.
defects.fix: The money trace shows the online payment with its gateway reference, attempts, status history and refunds.

defects.title: A cancelled subscription can still be edited
defects.actual: PATCH /api/subscriptions/<id> {quantityMilli:3000} on a CANCELLED subscription → 200.
defects.expected: 409: a finished subscription cannot change.
defects.fix: Editing or overriding a finished subscription answers 409 (loadLiveSubscription).

defects.title: Bad subscription start dates give 500; past dates accepted
defects.actual: startDate '', '2026-02-31' or 'tomorrow' → 500; yesterday → 201.
defects.expected: 422 for bad or past dates.
defects.fix: Shared isoDateSchema / todayOrLaterDateSchema: blank, impossible, text and past start dates → 422.

defects.title: A negative rider payout is not flagged
defects.actual: COD netting gave −₹1,951.98 but the payout was an ordinary PENDING payout, not in /api/finance/exceptions.
defects.expected: A negative net is held and listed as an exception.
defects.fix: A negative payout cannot be approved, processed or paid (409) and negative payouts and settlements are listed in the exceptions.

defects.title: Bad skip / pause / override dates give 500
defects.actual: POST /api/subscriptions/<id>/skip {date:''} or 'next friday' → 500.
defects.expected: 422 for a date that is not a real YYYY-MM-DD.
defects.fix: The same date schema on skip, override, pause, retry, renew, edit and deliveries routes → 422, not 500.

defects.title: Off-step subscription quantities are accepted
defects.actual: quantityMilli 2300 (2.3 L) accepted though the page cannot make it; stock taken in whole units while 2.3 L was charged.
defects.expected: Only the page's steps and range are accepted.
defects.fix: src/lib/subscription-quantity.ts: steps of 0.5 L / 0.5 kg (else one pack), at most 50 units, on the server and every quantity control.

defects.title: Marking another user's notification read is not refused
defects.actual: PATCH /api/notifications {id: someone else's} → 200 (nothing changed).
defects.expected: 404 for a notification that is not the caller's.
defects.fix: PATCH /api/notifications answers 404 for an id that is not the caller's.

defects.title: Verifying an unpaid top-up gives 500 when the gateway is unreachable
defects.actual: POST /api/wallet/verify → 500 (fetch failed to the gateway) instead of a clear refusal.
defects.expected: 400 PAYMENT_VERIFICATION_FAILED or a clear 'try again', never 500.
defects.fix: No gateway call for a mock payment or without keys; an unreachable gateway gives 400 'try again' and the payment is not failed.

defects.title: Wallet amount 10.555 is rounded instead of refused
defects.actual: On /wallet 10.555 started a payment of ₹10.56.
defects.expected: More than 2 decimals is refused.
defects.fix: /wallet and the shop wallet read the amount as typed (parseRupeeInput): more than 2 decimals refused.

defects.title: Low-balance threshold has no upper limit
defects.actual: PATCH /api/wallet/settings {lowBalanceThresholdPaise: ₹10 crore} → 200.
defects.expected: A sensible maximum.
defects.fix: Low-balance threshold and auto-recharge figures capped at rule walletTopup.maxPaise.

defects.title: Cart button says 'Pay from wallet' when 'Pay online' is chosen
defects.actual: With Pay online chosen the button still read 'Pay from wallet'; the 'Pay with' label wrapped all three radios.
defects.expected: The button names the chosen method; each radio is labelled by its own text.
defects.fix: The cart button names the chosen method; 'Pay with' is a fieldset, each radio named by its own label.

defects.title: A suspended rider can still accept the offer in hand
defects.actual: PATCH /api/delivery-orders/{id} {action:'accept'} by a suspended rider → 200 ASSIGNED; open offers were not withdrawn on suspension.
defects.expected: The offer can no longer be accepted; it goes to another rider.
defects.fix: Accept refuses a rider who may not work (409, checked on the locked row); suspending or deactivating withdraws open offers and the order is offered again.

defects.title: Rider reliability and fairness ranking never applies
defects.actual: The ranking subqueries compared the subquery's own id, so delivered/failed/declined/offers-today were always 0.
defects.expected: A rider who declines more, or had more offers today, ranks lower.
defects.fix: The ranking subqueries name delivery_partners.id in full, so declines, failures and offers today count.

defects.title: No 'Cancel order' button after pickup
defects.actual: The server allows a goods-only cancel at PICKED_UP / OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, but My Orders and the order page showed no button.
defects.expected: The button appears wherever the server allows a cancel.
defects.fix: One shared rule (src/lib/order-cancellation.ts) for the server, the cancellation quote and both My Orders pages.

defects.title: Rider KYC and bank numbers are not format-checked
defects.actual: PAN 'ABC12', Aadhaar '12', 8- or 19-digit or lettered bank accounts and malformed IFSC codes were accepted.
defects.expected: Each number is checked against its format with a clear message.
defects.fix: src/lib/kyc/rider-details.ts checks PAN, Aadhaar (Verhoeff), IFSC and bank account for the application and change requests; field messages on the form.

defects.title: 1.5 of a per-piece item can be returned
defects.actual: A return of 1.5 of a packaged line → 201.
defects.expected: Per-piece lines are returned in whole pieces.
defects.fix: Lines sold by count are returned in whole pieces (the full remaining quantity always allowed); the form checks the same.

defects.title: A suspended or rejected rider can be approved again with no reason
defects.actual: 'reactivate' needed no reason; 'approve' also moved SUSPENDED and REJECTED riders to APPROVED.
defects.expected: Approve only from review; reactivating needs a reason.
defects.fix: Approve only from REGISTERED / UNDER_REVIEW (409 otherwise); reactivate needs a reason, kept in the review note and audit.

defects.title: No notice to the rider on reactivate or deactivate
defects.actual: Approve, reject and suspend send a notice; reactivate and deactivate did not.
defects.expected: Every status change is notified.
defects.fix: Notices delivery_partner.reactivated and delivery_partner.deactivated.

defects.title: Vehicle numbers are not normalised or checked
defects.actual: 'mh12 ab 1234' stored as typed in one place, upper-cased in another; 'MH12@#$%^&*' accepted.
defects.expected: One format everywhere; symbols refused.
defects.fix: normaliseVehicleRegistration(): upper case, single spaces, Indian mark or BH series, at application and profile edit.

defects.title: Cancelling during the rider search leaves the search running
defects.actual: After a cancel, GET /api/orders/{id}/assign still said 'Looking for a rider — attempt 1 of 10'.
defects.expected: The search closes with the order.
defects.fix: Cancelling an order stops its rider search and open broadcast; the dispatch sweep closes stale ones.

defects.title: The remove-line reason accepts anything
defects.actual: Reason 'Banana' → 200.
defects.expected: Only the reasons the shop page offers.
defects.fix: The remove-line reason is one of the shop page's list ('Out of stock', 'Unavailable'; none = Unavailable).

defects.title: The failed-delivery reason accepts anything
defects.actual: Reason 'Banana' → 200.
defects.expected: Only the reasons the rider page offers.
defects.fix: The rider screen asks for a free-text reason, so any text within the length rules is valid. Turning it into a list is a product decision.

defects.title: Grievance phone unchecked; ticket lookup reveals which tickets exist
defects.actual: Phone 'not a phone' → 201; unknown ticket → 404 but an existing ticket with the wrong e-mail → 403.
defects.expected: Phone checked; both lookups answer the same.
defects.fix: A grievance phone is checked as an Indian mobile; an unknown ticket and a wrong e-mail get the same 404.

defects.title: Admin refund form rounds 10.555 instead of refusing it
defects.actual: /admin/finance 'Refund an order' refunded ₹10.56 for '10.555'.
defects.expected: More than 2 decimals is refused.
defects.fix: src/lib/rupee-input.ts refuses more than 2 decimals on the refund and adjustment forms.

defects.title: Riders can be approved with no identity documents
defects.actual: Approve with no rows in delivery_partner_documents → 200 APPROVED.
defects.expected: The plan expects KYC pending until documents are in; the application form calls ID details optional — owner decision.
defects.fix: Unchanged: approval needs no documents because the application calls ID details optional. Note: seller KYC refuses Aadhaar numbers on legal grounds while the rider form collects them.

defects.title: A product can be put on sale at ₹0
defects.actual: PATCH /api/shop-products/{id} {onlineSaleEnabled:true, onlinePricePaise:0} → 200; the product sells at ₹0.
defects.expected: A price on sale is at least ₹0.01.
defects.fix: A price on sale is ₹0.01 to ₹10 lakh in the service, every listing route and price proposals.

defects.title: The shop page shows only the first 100 products
defects.actual: A shop with 662 products: category X and its products never appeared on /shops/{slug}?cat=X.
defects.expected: Every product can be reached; a chosen category shows its products.
defects.fix: The shop page counts categories in SQL and loads only the chosen category, a page at a time.

defects.title: Excel price list: 0 is valid, blank is an error
defects.actual: A 0 in a loose price cell was VALID (would set ₹0); a blank cell was INVALID_PRICE.
defects.expected: 0 is refused like everywhere else; blank means no change.
defects.fix: Excel price list: 0 is invalid; a blank cell is no change for a product already listed.

defects.title: Referral performance report gives 500
defects.actual: GET /api/referral-codes?report=1 → 500 'Do not know how to serialize a BigInt'.
defects.expected: The report is returned.
defects.fix: The referral report returns numbers (no BigInt).

defects.title: A suspended or approved (trading) shop can be rejected
defects.actual: Reject after suspend → 200 (SUSPENDED → REJECTED, two audit rows); reject of an APPROVED, trading shop → 200 and the owner was told the registration 'wasn't approved'.
defects.expected: 409: only a shop under review can be rejected.
defects.fix: Only a pending, live shop can be rejected (409 otherwise); reasons trimmed before the 3–500 check.

defects.title: Invalid GSTINs are accepted
defects.actual: State codes 00 and 99, a wrong check character and a GSTIN carrying another PAN were accepted.
defects.expected: Structure, state code, checksum and PAN are checked.
defects.fix: parseGstin checks the state code (01–38, 97) and the check character; the GSTIN's PAN must match the shop's PAN on file.

defects.title: A GST certificate valid 'To: Not Applicable' is blocked as expired
defects.actual: 'Period of Validity From 01/04/2020 To Not Applicable' was read as expired on 2020-04-01.
defects.expected: No expiry date means no expiry.
defects.fix: 'To : Not Applicable' (or NA) means no expiry; a 'From' date is never read as the expiry.

defects.title: Impossible opening times are accepted
defects.actual: '25:00', 'morning' and open = close were accepted.
defects.expected: HH:MM 00:00–23:59 and open ≠ close.
defects.fix: Opening hours HH:MM 00:00–23:59, opening ≠ closing on an open day, each day once; the settings form checks the same.

defects.title: Product master: GST '-5' read as 5 %, 7 % accepted
defects.actual: The pipeline dropped the sign of -5; the admin GST editor accepted 7 %.
defects.expected: Negative and non-slab rates are refused.
defects.fix: '-5' is no longer read as 5 %; non-slab rates are dropped with a warning in the pipeline and refused by the admin GST editor.

defects.title: MRP of ₹0 or ₹10 crore accepted
defects.actual: POST /api/mrp mrpPaise 0 and 10,000,000,000 → 200; an MRP correction claim of 0 → 201.
defects.expected: MRP between ₹0.01 and a sane maximum.
defects.fix: MRP and MRP correction claims ₹0.01 to ₹10 lakh (MAX_MRP_PAISE), in the routes and the product master.

defects.title: A product removed from a shop cannot be listed again
defects.actual: 'Add existing product' offered it but POST /api/shops/{id}/products → 409 'already in your shop's catalogue' (soft-deleted listing counted).
defects.expected: A removed product can be listed again.
defects.fix: A removed product can be listed again (the soft-deleted listing is brought back).

defects.title: An owner cannot close their shop
defects.actual: No control on /shop or /shop/manage; PATCH {status:'CLOSED'} → 422.
defects.expected: The owner can close the shop (open orders, payouts and wallet handled) — feature gap.
defects.fix: Not built: closing a shop needs decisions on open orders, payouts and the shop wallet.

defects.title: Product card shows no MRP strike-through or discount
defects.actual: MRP ₹60 / price ₹58 read '… ₹58 each …' with no MRP and no % off.
defects.expected: MRP struck through and '% off' when the price is below the MRP.
defects.fix: Product cards show the MRP struck through and 'x% off' (rounded down, from 1 %).

defects.title: Inventory form rounds 10.555 instead of refusing it
defects.actual: /shop/inventory saved '10.555' as ₹10.56.
defects.expected: More than 2 decimals is refused.
defects.fix: Price boxes read the amount as typed (parsePriceInput on the shared parseRupeeInput): more than 2 decimals, 0 and text refused.

defects.title: A closed (deleted) shop can be approved
defects.actual: POST /api/shops/{id}/approve on a shop with deleted_at set → 200 APPROVED.
defects.expected: Refused.
defects.fix: Approving a closed (deleted) shop answers 409.

defects.title: Shop address of spaces accepted; text not trimmed
defects.actual: Address '      ' → 201; '   12 Padded Road   ' stored untrimmed.
defects.expected: Trimmed, then checked.
defects.fix: Registration and settings text trimmed before its length check; spaces-only optional fields become empty.

defects.title: Stored FSSAI number accepts anything
defects.actual: PATCH /api/shops/{id}/compliance accepted 13 or 15 digits or letters.
defects.expected: 14 digits, as the owner's own entry already checks.
defects.fix: The stored FSSAI number uses the owner's own rule (14 digits).

defects.title: No upper limit on minimum order, delivery fee or free-delivery threshold
defects.actual: ₹10 crore accepted for each.
defects.expected: Sensible maxima.
defects.fix: Minimum order and free-delivery threshold up to ₹1 lakh, delivery fee up to ₹5,000.

defects.title: No preparation-time setting for the shop
defects.actual: No field on any owner screen; PATCH {preparationTimeMinutes} → 422, though slots and alerts use it.
defects.expected: The owner can set it within a range.
defects.fix: Preparation time (5–240 min) in the owner's delivery settings.

defects.title: Line breaks in the shop description are dropped
defects.actual: The shop page collapsed the description's line breaks.
defects.expected: Line breaks kept (text still escaped).
defects.fix: The shop description keeps its line breaks (still escaped).

defects.title: A 'javascript:' logo URL is accepted; no logo upload
defects.actual: logoUrl 'javascript:alert(1)' → 200; there is no logo upload control.
defects.expected: Only https: logo URLs; an upload control (feature gap).
defects.fix: Logo and photo addresses must be https or the site's own image path (javascript:, data:, http: → 422). Open (feature gap): there is no logo upload control.

defects.title: Product master: '-1 kg' read as 1 kg; any unit accepted
defects.actual: The pipeline read '-1 kg' as 1000 g; the create-product API accepted unit 'bananas'.
defects.expected: Negative or zero quantities flagged; only known units.
defects.fix: The product master flags zero and negative quantities; products accept only the catalogue's units (a list on the form).

defects.title: Order monitoring's date filter uses UTC days, not IST
defects.actual: An order at 01:30 IST on 24 Oct was listed under 23 Oct; orders placed 00:00–05:30 IST were filed under the previous day.
defects.expected: The chosen day is the business day (IST).
defects.fix: The order monitoring date filter uses IST business-day bounds, as analytics does.

defects.title: Some staff and shop routes answer 422 (field names) instead of 403
defects.actual: A signed-in customer, or another shop's owner, sending an empty body got 422 VALIDATION_FAILED from payout batches, canned replies, cancellation fee, segments, profile setup and staff: the body was read before the permission check.
defects.expected: 403 before the body is read.
defects.fix: Permission or shop access checked before the body on payout batches, canned replies, cancellation fee, segments, profile setup and staff. POST /api/price-requests keeps its order (an owner in the customer role may submit there).

defects.title: Address form: a server refusal highlights no field
defects.actual: Address line 1 over 200 characters → 'Please check the highlighted fields.' at the top and no field highlighted; the inputs had no length limit.
defects.expected: The message shows on the field; inputs stop at the API's limits.
defects.fix: The address form shows the server's message on its field and names the fields at the top; inputs stop at the API's limits.

defects.title: Vouchers with a ₹0 budget, past dates or a budget below one bonus are accepted
defects.actual: POST /api/vouchers → 201 for each.
defects.expected: Each refused with a field message.
defects.fix: Vouchers: budget under ₹0.01, an end date already past, a budget below one maximum bonus and impossible dates refused with field messages (edits re-check changed fields only).

defects.title: Reject and classification reasons are stored with outer spaces
defects.actual: '   QA …   ' stored as typed.
defects.expected: Trimmed before the 3–500 check and stored trimmed.
defects.fix: Reject and classification reasons are trimmed before the 3–500 check and stored trimmed.

defects.title: A return on an online-paid order is never refunded
defects.actual: Return accepted → 404 'Original wallet debit for this reference was not found'; the return stayed REFUND_INITIATED with no refund, credit note or gateway refund.
defects.expected: The return is refunded the way the order was paid.
defects.fix: refundDeliveredOrder refunds online orders to the payment (after commit) for returns, disputes and admin refunds.

defects.title: A physical stock count makes the product unavailable online
defects.actual: 100 online / 100 in-shop, then a count of 37 → online 0, in-shop 37, not available online.
defects.expected: A count sets the physical total without emptying the online channel.
defects.fix: A count takes a shortfall from the in-shop count first, then online; an increase goes to the purchase channel.

defects.title: A returned unopened unit is not put back in stock
defects.actual: Unopened return accepted: stock 8 → 8, no movement.
defects.expected: Stock goes back up by the returned units.
defects.fix: Accepted UNOPENED returns go back in stock in the same transaction (stock ledger SALE_RETURN).

defects.title: A substitution does not give the original item's stock back
defects.actual: Both the original and the substitute were taken from stock.
defects.expected: The original's unit goes back; only the substitute is taken.
defects.fix: Approving a substitute puts the original product back in stock (ledger: sale return of the order).

defects.title: A stale stock save overwrites a sale made meanwhile
defects.actual: A page opened at stock 10 saved 8 after an order took 4: stock became 8 (true 6).
defects.expected: The save is refused with the current figure.
defects.fix: The listing save sends the stock it was opened with; if it moved, 409 'Stock changed … it is now N'.

defects.title: The public storefront API shows exact stock
defects.actual: GET /api/shops/{id}/products as a customer returned onlineStock for every row.
defects.expected: Only the shop and operations see the number; others see availability.
defects.fix: The public products API returns inStock, not the count (owner, staff and operations still get counts). Product cards still receive stock capped at 99 for the quantity picker.

defects.title: Order lines record no MRP
defects.actual: order_items has no MRP column, so an order cannot show or prove the MRP at the time of sale.
defects.expected: Each line keeps the MRP it was sold under (schema change).
defects.fix: Not built: order_items has no MRP column; keeping the MRP per line needs a schema change and the invoice to show it.

defects.title: Order pages lack unit price and payment method
defects.actual: The customer's order page and the shop's order card show neither.
defects.expected: Both show each line's unit price and how the order is paid.
defects.fix: Unit price per line and the payment method on the customer's order page and the shop's order card.

defects.title: The order e-mail has no lines or totals
defects.actual: The body is only 'Your order … is confirmed' and a link.
defects.expected: Lines, fees, discount and total in the e-mail.
defects.fix: The order-confirmed e-mail lists the lines, delivery fee, discount and total.

defects.title: Out-of-stock products are not listed after buyable ones
defects.actual: An out-of-stock row came first on the storefront.
defects.expected: Buyable products first.
defects.fix: Storefront lists buyable products first.

defects.title: Loose stock cannot hold decimals
defects.actual: Stock 2.5 → 422; a count of 2.5 kg left 2; 250 g of a 1 kg-unit loose product cannot be sold.
defects.expected: Loose stock in grams / millilitres (design change: stock is whole units today).
defects.fix: Not built: stock is held in whole units; loose stock in grams / millilitres is a design change.

defects.title: Inventory page has no filters or sort
defects.actual: No category, low-stock or out-of-stock filter and no sort on /shop/inventory.
defects.expected: Filters and sort (enhancement).
defects.fix: Not built: inventory filters and sort are an enhancement.

defects.title: Stock and price fields have no upper bounds; forms round decimals
defects.actual: Prices of ₹10 crore, stock and thresholds of 99,999,999, a write-off of 1.5 packaged units, unit 'bananas' and pack size 0 or negative were accepted; a blank stock box saved 0; forms rounded ₹10.555.
defects.expected: Sensible bounds, whole units for per-piece items, known units only, no silent rounding.
defects.fix: Prices up to ₹10 lakh, stock and thresholds up to 10 lakh, whole units for packaged write-offs and counts, known units only; the stock box cannot be left blank.

defects.title: Finance entries have no upper bounds; an unfinished week can be settled
defects.actual: A ₹10 crore registration fee, shop payment and adjustment were accepted; a payment with a blank or reused reference or a future date was accepted; forms rounded ₹10.555; the current, unfinished week (and a future one) could be settled.
defects.expected: Bounds, a unique reference, no future dates, no rounding, finished weeks only.
defects.fix: src/lib/money-limits.ts (₹10,00,000) on registration fees, shop payments, adjustments and COD deposits; non-cash shop payments need a reference, a reused one gets 409, a future date 422; only a finished week can be settled; the deposit, refund and adjustment forms refuse more than 2 decimals.

defects.title: After the round-2 release, test.gokesari.com refused every session (sign-in did not stick)
defects.found: 2026-10-24 test.gokesari.com, right after the round-2 fixes (PR #232) were deployed
defects.actual: Every saved session was refused and a fresh sign-in set the session cookie, but the next page treated the visitor as signed out (POST /signin 200, then /onboarding → /signin). The new sign-out check reads revoked_sessions on every request; when that read fails, the request has no session.
defects.expected: A signed-in visitor stays signed in; a failure of the sign-out list never signs everyone out.
defects.fix: src/server/auth-sessions.ts readSession: if the revoked_sessions check fails, the account is read on its own and the failure is logged once, so sessions keep working (only signed-out copies are not refused until the check works); tests/integration/auth-sessions-fallback.test.ts. PR #234.

defects.title: The host's firewall answers some requests itself (SQL-like search text, bursts)
defects.actual: /search?q=';%20drop%20table%20shops;-- → 403 from the hosting firewall (Hostinger), before the app. During the long access sweeps on test.gokesari.com it also answered a burst itself for a minute or more: /shop/offers → 307 to itself and /search?q=दूध → 403, both fine from curl and on a second run.
defects.expected: Not an app defect: the case's own inputs (%, _, ', ", <script>, Hindi, long text) all render; the probe was narrowed to them. Recorded so a 403 on such text is not mistaken for an app error. The suite now tells the host's answers from the app's (app pages carry 'Vary: rsc'; lib/http.ts fromApp()): it looks again after a pause and records a host answer as a note or blocked, never as an app failure.
defects.fix: None in the app (host configuration).
